subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` become the fail-closed ceiling for WebSocket and Unix connection upgrades, including existing setups with unusually slow handshakes?
rationale: The patch fixes an indefinite hang without adding configuration, but it broadens an existing setting's semantics and can intentionally stop previously tolerated connections; repository policy requires explicit owner intent for that compatibility choice.

options.title: Reuse request timeout
options.body: Confirm that the existing resolved request timeout owns both connection upgrades and control-plane calls, then land the documented fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Separate handshake policy
options.body: Use a distinct or derived handshake budget if direct Codex and `ws` inspection shows connection establishment should not share the request budget.

options.title: Preserve indefinite compatibility
options.body: Do not add the deadline until maintainers accept the risk of terminating slow existing upgrades.

recommendation.title: Reuse request timeout
recommendation.body: Confirm that the existing resolved request timeout owns both connection upgrades and control-plane calls, then land the documented fail-closed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available recent history across Codex app-server runtime, configuration, and harness documentation.
